evidence_excerpts: The edge distance is defined over uniformly spaced samples along the edges, d(e_i,e_j)=sqrt(sum_k ||e_ik-e_jk||^2), with N in [50,100], and the authors report that full-linkage HBA gives the best results.
text: Hierarchical agglomerative clustering with full linkage and Euclidean distances between uniformly sampled edge points yields clusters of geometrically close edges that follow graph structure.
